query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS olfactive_archives (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  type ENUM('manuscript','formula','archaeological','botanical_illustration') NOT NULL,
  date_created VARCHAR(100),
  civilization VARCHAR(255),
  plant_ids JSON,
  molecule_ids JSON,
  description TEXT,
  provenance TEXT,
  authenticity_level ENUM('confirmed','probable','hypothetical') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'probable',
  `references` JSON,
  image_url VARCHAR(500),
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX olfactive_archives_type_idx (type),
  INDEX olfactive_archives_civilization_idx (civilization)
);
